answer: Each new identity also requires an orchard-signed voucher from two existing members, and every attestation is logged with a unique quill-marked nonce to prevent replay. An agent must stake a bonded deposit plus compute a verifiable proof-of-work tied to its identity key before joining the oasis registry. Sybil attackers must therefore burn real stake and scarce vouchers per fake identity, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0230's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
